units: Selected factual annotations, no exhaustive event count
note: Original paraphrases with primary citations. Coordinates approximate named city/region anchors, not footprints. A date may mark a reporting cutoff rather than the onset of an event; the card says which.

items.title: Event coverage ends in August
items.text: The shipped UCDP record ends in August 2026. Candidate data is preliminary. The 14 October editorial cutoff does not extend its observation window.

items.title: Displacement observation window
items.text: Annual refugee stocks stop at end-2025; the separate operational IDP estimate also refers to year-end 2025. Neither is an October 2026 census.

items.title: Image observation window
items.text: The three NASA Kyiv images stop in May 2022. They illustrate an early-war comparison and cannot be relabelled as a current infrastructure assessment.
